question: Which Non-Small Cell Lung trials used Chemo+Anti-VEGF as the control arm?

gemini.answer: This query retrieves the NCT, author, year, and PubMed ID of clinical trials for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) where the control arm used a Chemo/Anti-VEGF regimen.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%NSCLC%' AND \"control_regimen\" ILIKE '%Chemo/Anti-VEGF%'",
  "answer": "This query retrieves the NCT, author, year, and PubMed ID of clinical trials for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) where the control arm used a Chemo/Anti-VEGF regimen.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
